storyCards.headline: It's Only Make Believe: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Conway Twitty's "It's Only Make Believe" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 21 weeks on the chart.

It's Only Make Believe was released in 1958.

"It's Only Make Believe" by Conway Twitty.

Chart story — peaked at #1 on the Hot 100.
